records.source: Hey, @. Surprised? ...I finally found the courage to come down here.#$b#I felt scared at first, but I pushed through.#$b#I feel much more confident now. This is actually really fun!$h
records.translation: Hoy, @. Nagulat ka? ...Sa wakas ay nagkalakas-loob akong bumaba rito.#$b#Natakot ako noong una, pero nagpatuloy ako.#$b#Mas tiwala na ako sa sarili ko ngayon. Talagang napakasaya nito!$h

records.source: Hey! I made it pretty far, didn't I?$h
records.translation: Hoy! Medyo malayo ang narating ko, hindi ba?$h

records.source: Eep!$7#$b#Hahah! You scared me! I didn't expect to see another person down here!$h#$e#Sorry, I'm all sweaty from excitement...
records.translation: Eep!$7#$b#Hahah! Nagulat mo ako! Hindi ko inasahang makakita ng ibang tao rito sa ibaba!$h#$e#Paumanhin, pawis na pawis ako sa pagkasabik...

records.source: Hi @! I made it here without fighting any monsters...
records.translation: Kumusta @! Nakarating ako rito nang hindi nakikipaglaban sa anumang halimaw...

records.source: Hey! It's a relief to see you down here...$h#$e#Um... don't tell my Dad I'm here, okay?$9
records.translation: Hoy! Nakakagaan ng loob na makita ka rito sa ibaba...$h#$e#Um... huwag mong sabihin kay Tatay na narito ako, ha?$9

records.source: Hey! Exploring the mines on a rainy day, huh? Me too!$h
records.translation: Hoy! Naglilibot ka sa mga minahan sa maulang araw, ha? Ako rin!$h

records.source: Gweee-ah!! Human!#$b#...You want to pass? I'm sorry, this is private property.$s
records.translation: Gweee-ah!! Tao!#$b#...Gusto mong dumaan? Paumanhin, pribadong pag-aari ito.$s

records.source: I'm sorry, but I can't let you pass... I'd lose my job.
records.translation: Paumanhin, pero hindi kita maaaring padaanin... Mawawalan ako ng trabaho.

records.source: You're offering this to me? Hmm... no thanks.$s
records.translation: Iniaalok mo ito sa akin? Hmm... huwag na.$s

records.source: Mmmm... that looks fresh, but no thanks... why don't you have it?
records.translation: Mmmm... mukhang sariwa iyan, pero huwag na... ikaw na lang ang kumain.
*singhot*...*singhot*...#$b#Ang amoy na iyon...#$b#Hindi ko mapigilan... Akin na iyan!$h

records.source: What's that... you're looking for a dark talisman?#$b#...Hmmm. Now that you mention it, I did have one in my possession not too long ago.#$b#Unfortunately, I dropped it while exploring that tunnel in the far corner.#$b#Things started heating up in there, so I left in a hurry and sealed the entrance.#$b#You seem pretty sturdy, though... So I'll open it back up for you. Just be careful, okay?
records.translation: Ano iyon... naghahanap ka ng madilim na anting-anting?#$b#...Hmmm. Ngayong nabanggit mo, mayroon nga akong isa hindi pa katagalan.#$b#Sa kasamaang-palad, nahulog ko iyon habang ginagalugad ang lagusan sa dulong sulok.#$b#Nagsimulang uminit doon, kaya dali-dali akong umalis at isinara ang pasukan.#$b#Mukhang matibay ka naman... Kaya bubuksan ko ulit iyon para sa iyo. Mag-ingat ka lang, ha?

records.source: This... Are you trying to hurt me even more?$s
records.translation: Ito... Sinusubukan mo ba akong saktan lalo?$s
